name: HOTEL YOSHI KAOHSIUNG
detail: The overall stay experience was very good, with a convenient location, spacious room, comfortable bathroom, stable hot water supply, and pleasing views. The in-room WiFi performed well, and the facilities were complete and well-maintained; the cleanliness was reassuring, and the staff provided friendly and attentive service. Overall, the quality of the accommodation is commensurate with the price, making it a recommended choice.

name: Hotel YAM LAGOM
detail: The hotel room is not large, but it has a small balcony with a sea view, and it is cleaned very well every day, making for a comfortable stay. The hotel's location is also excellent, with many famous restaurants nearby, a large supermarket, and it’s within walking distance to the Pier-2 Art Center. Various means of transportation are very convenient. The hotel staff is warm and hospitable, recommending delicious food and patiently listening to guests' requests. I will definitely stay at this hotel again on my next visit to Kaohsiung, and I sincerely recommend it to everyone.

name: River Trees Hotel
detail: I stayed for 2 nights on the last weekend of September. They gave me a room on the 3rd floor with a picturesque view, so I was satisfied. The room was clean and spacious enough even with two open suitcases. The bus stop and tram are nearby, making it an ideal location for visiting the Boal Art District and Chi-Chin Island. It seems like a clean start for my first trip to Taiwan. I would recommend it to others and would visit again.

name: River inn Station
detail: Within walking distance from Beautiful Island Station. There is also a bus stop nearby, making it easy to go to Sanpho Shrine. The breakfast was delicious, and light snacks were also provided in the evening. The air conditioning worked well, the shower had good water pressure and temperature, the room was clean, access was good, and it was reassuring to have staff at the front desk even at late hours. The size of the room is probably acceptable for a solo traveler, but it might feel cramped for two people. I’ve seen comments from others regarding odors in the rooms. However, in the morning, I noticed a sewer smell coming up from the shower room, so I would recommend taking a shower in the evening. If you keep the bathroom door closed, the smell did not fill the bedroom. When I returned from being out at night, the smell had disappeared, so it was not unbearable.

name: The Riverside Hotel International
detail: I stayed on the last night for an early morning flight the next day. The early morning van was already full, but when I asked the front desk, they arranged a taxi for me. As others have mentioned, they also prepared breakfast for me to take. The room felt somewhat smaller compared to other hotels, but it was perfect for a one-night stay before my return flight. The hotel itself was new, clean, and my stay was very comfortable.

name: Single Inn - Kaohsiung Station
detail: It's narrow but a private room. As of early October, there is no air conditioning in the room, but it stays cool. There is a shower on the floor I stayed on, but there is a separate bathing area on the second floor. The refreshing feeling from the shower and the bathing area is completely different. Breakfast is included. The Rosaohan (Lu Rou Fan) is exceptional. Washing machine (10 yuan × 5 sheets), dryer (10 yuan × 5 sheets). Detergent is provided.

name: Ahiruyah Guest House
detail: Many people at the front desk can speak Japanese, so even Japanese people who cannot speak Chinese can check in and out smoothly. Since guests take off their shoes at the entrance and switch to slippers, the floors are clean. It's also nice that a 7/11 and a night market are nearby. We rented a room for two people, but since we only used it for sleeping, there were no particular issues. It was convenient that we didn’t have to carry a room key as long as we remembered the passcode. Since we had exclusive access to one room, cleaning staff did not enter, and we could always stay comfortably. It seems that in the dormitory, cleaning happens in the morning with the doors open. The shower room lacks a changing area, so if you wear long pants, the ends will get wet, and if your belongings or clothes placed on the shelf above fall, they will get soaked, so I was always careful. The water pressure in the shower was strong, and I was satisfied with it.

name: Skyone Hotel
detail: It takes about 2-3 minutes to reach from Exit 4 of MRT Qianjin Station, and there's a bus stop nearby, plus the night market is within walking distance, and there's a Ubike station right in front, making it convenient to move around anywhere. I stayed in a City View room, which was spacious and had a bathtub, and I could see a beautiful sunset from the window, making me feel like I got a good deal. They provide two key cards, so I was able to keep drinks cool in the fridge while out, which was very helpful. There’s a washing machine and dryer on the 11th floor for TWD 30. Breakfast cost TWD 99, but I didn't use it this time as there was something I wanted to eat instead. The staff were very polite, and I had a very comfortable stay. However, there was a unique smell that might bother some people (the room itself was fine; it was more noticeable in the lobby and elevator). Additionally, due to the affordable accommodation, the clientele wasn't that great. There were people talking loudly in the hallway early in the morning and late at night, and sometimes I felt uncomfortable in the lobby. Nevertheless, it was a hotel I would want to stay at again.

name: Han Hsien International Hotel
detail: It was a room next to the elevator, but there was no noise at all. It looks a bit old, but it is well maintained and I was very satisfied! It was 110,000 won for one night, and there is a gym and swimming pool, and right next to it is Wubaochun Bakery, with Daewoo Beef Noodle across the street!

name: Kindness Hotel - Kaohsiung Main Station
detail: I just stayed from September 24, 2026, and I have to say I'm very impressed. ❤️ The accommodation is right next to Kaohsiung Main Station, just a short walk out of gate 3-4, very convenient. The place is great, and the service is excellent. The staff can speak English, making communication easy. They provide a welcome drink of tea, coffee, and unlimited ice cream. 🍦☕️ Another thing I liked is that there is a separate lounge area from the luggage storage, which looks very tidy. As soon as I walked into the hotel, it smelled nice. The room was clean, with no musty or strange smells. The price is quite economical and very worthwhile. Breakfast has a huge selection and every dish is delicious. 😋 In the evening, they also offer free craft beer, so anyone wanting to relax after a day out will find it convenient. 🍺 Overall, I am very impressed, giving it a full score of 10! 💯 If you're looking for accommodation near Kaohsiung Main Station, I highly recommend this place. It's worth it and you won't be disappointed. ❤️
